page.layout: Running head at top left, page number at top right. One column of running text, with short marginal notes in the right margin beside the second paragraph. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~3 letters] iudicaturus est orbem terrarum, per eum quem definiit, & cap.26.10. Annuntiavit Judaeis & Gentibus, ut resipiscerent & converterentur ad Deum, opera facientes digna iis qui resipuissent.

Hæc & similia agnoscimus, & indeSed non exclusâ Christi satisfactione. concludimus, requiri à nobis veram conversionem & resipiscentiam ex parte nostra; At inde non efficitur, ex parte Dei nō requiri ullam satisfactionem pro peccatis nostris. Deus est, qui remittit peccata & justificat, qui se solum esse Servatorem nostrum affirmat, qui iniquitates nostras propter seipsum delet[?]. Iesa. 43. 11. Remittit seu condonat peccata ex gratuita bonitate, pura gratia & Misericordia sua, ex quâ & nobis datum est IESUS CHRI-STUS, Agnus ille Dei, tollens peccata Mundi, ex quâ & nobis conceditur Fides, per quam Christi participes fiamus.

Hac gratiâ & liberalitate excludi quidem operum nostrorum merita dicimus, quibus scilicet justitiam ac salutem promereamur. Ex misericordia item hac nobis peccata condonari absq; jacturâ justitiæ Dei concedimus, quia

page.notes: Right margin note "Sed non exclusâ Christi satisfactione." is set in small italic type and was read from a damaged scan; its line breaks are reconstructed. The first word of the page is partly lost, so its letters are uncertain. "delet" at the end of the second paragraph has a superscript letter after "delc" that I could not resolve confidently. The left-hand page number, printed beside the running head, is too faint to read, so only the right-hand number is given. The text "ita" at the foot is treated as a catchword because it stands alone below the last line.
